summary: SESI #19: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of unified 'PDF & Kop Surat' screen. All core features verified working: single unified screen replaces two old screens, deep link navigation, preview panel with mode toggle, letterhead configuration, table column management, signature blocks (up to 4), logo upload control, save/reset functionality, and cleanup. Backend already verified green by gate scripts.

minor_observations.issue: Hub-level tabs (Perusahaan, API Keys) not visible when using deep link #mgmt-pdf
minor_observations.impact: Minor - Deep link works correctly and takes user directly to PDF screen. Hub tabs may be accessible via different navigation path.
minor_observations.note: This may be intentional behavior for deep links. Internal PDF tabs (Kop Surat, Kolom Tabel, Tanda Tangan, Footer & Gaya Tabel) all work correctly.
